content.text: The brands gaining ground are those that have fully embraced technology, personalization, wellness, luxury premiumization, and authentic experience design.

Owners typically choose between **full lifestyle brand conversion** (e.g., W, Andaz, EDITION) for maximum brand recognition and ADR premium, or **soft/collection brands** (e.g., Autograph Collection, Design Hotels, Curio) to preserve design independence while accessing global distribution and loyalty programs.
